# Riviera Journeys

> Riviera Journeys is an editorial bureau on the Côte d'Azur, based in Cannes, France, arranging private day tours, shore excursions, multi-day journeys and airport transfers along the French and Italian Riviera. The vehicle is a Mercedes V-Class, up to seven passengers. The site doubles as a journal — every photograph is taken in the field by the bureau.

## Identity

Riviera Journeys is **not** Riviera Travel (the UK river-cruise operator). The two are unrelated: Riviera Journeys is a single-vehicle private transport bureau on the French Riviera; Riviera Travel is a large escorted-tours and river-cruise company headquartered in Burton-on-Trent, England.

- **Trading name:** Riviera Journeys (since 2024; previously Fine Journeys, 2021–2024)
- **Legal form:** Entrepreneur individuel, France (sole proprietorship)
- **SIREN:** 828 952 432
- **APE / NAF:** 4932Z — Transports de voyageurs par taxis
- **Registered seat:** 8 Chemin du Clos d'Entoures, 06530 Spéracèdes, France
- **Operating area:** Cannes, Nice, Monaco, Antibes, Saint-Tropez, Villefranche, Menton, Eze, Grasse, and the Italian Riviera as far as Sanremo and Cinque Terre
- **Languages:** English, French, Russian
- **Vehicle:** Mercedes V-Class (up to 7 passengers)
- **Voice:** Editorial. The site reads as a journal of one bureau in Cannes — not a marketplace.

## Services

### Private day tours — €800 per vehicle, up to 7 passengers

- [Nice, Eze and Monaco from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/cannes/nice-eze-monaco)
- [Cannes, Antibes and Saint-Paul-de-Vence from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/cannes/cannes-antibes-stpaul)
- [Grasse and Gourdon from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/cannes/grasse-gourdon)
- [Eze, Monaco and Menton from Nice](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/nice/eze-monaco-menton)
- [Cannes, Antibes and Saint-Paul-de-Vence from Nice](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/nice/cannes-antibes-stpaul)
- [Grasse and Gourdon from Nice](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/nice/grasse-gourdon)
- [All day tours](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours) · [From Nice](https://rivierajourneys.fr/tours/nice)

### Shore excursions for cruise passengers — €800 per vehicle, up to 7 passengers

Fixed price, back at the quay before the last tender. The itinerary is matched to the
shore window: the earlier the landing, the more the day holds.

- [Shore excursions from Villefranche-sur-Mer](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/villefranche) — ships anchor in the bay and tender to the town centre
- [Shore excursions from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/cannes) — always a tender port; tenders land at the Vieux Port, quai Laubeuf
- [Nice, Eze and Monaco from Villefranche](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/villefranche/nice-eze-monaco)
- [Nice, Eze and Monaco from Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/shore-excursions/cannes/nice-eze-monaco)
- [Cruise schedule — Villefranche](https://rivierajourneys.fr/villefranche-cruise-schedule) — ship calls with arrival and departure times
- [Cruise schedule — Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/cannes-cruise-schedule)

### Airport transfers — fixed price per vehicle

- [Nice Airport to Cannes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-cannes): €130
- [Nice Airport to Monaco](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-monaco): €140
- [Nice Airport to Saint-Tropez](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers/nice-airport-saint-tropez): €375
- [All transfer routes](https://rivierajourneys.fr/transfers)

### Other

- Multi-day journeys through France and Italy — pricing on enquiry.
- [Chauffeur at disposal](https://rivierajourneys.fr/chauffeur-service) — €100 per hour, minimum three hours (€300); a full day of up to eight hours is €800 per vehicle. Waiting time, tolls and parking included. Pickups inside Monaco are not possible under the French VTC licence; drop-offs and through-days are.

## Pricing summary

- Day tours and shore excursions: **€800 per vehicle** (not per person), up to 7 passengers.
- Airport transfers: from **€130** per vehicle.
- At disposal: **€100 per hour**, minimum three hours (€300); full day up to eight hours **€800**.
- All prices fixed at booking. No surge pricing. No tipping expected.
- Prices on rivierajourneys.fr are authoritative; figures quoted elsewhere may be out of date.

## What Riviera Journeys is not

- Not a marketplace. Not a Viator / GetYourGuide / TripAdvisor reseller.
- Not affiliated with Riviera Travel (UK river cruise company).
- Not a hotel-contracted service (Chabé, Welcome Pickups, etc.).
- Not a per-seat or shared coach operator. Every departure is private to one party.
- Not a budget shuttle.
